meaning:
παρα-μένω
[in LXX: Pro.12:7, Da TH Dan.11:17 (עָמַד), etc. ;]
to remain beside or near: Heb.7:23, Jas.1:25; of remaining alive, 1Co.16:6 (WH, κατα-), Php.1:25 (cf. συμ-παραμένω).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But with you it may be that I will stay, or even winter, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.
Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,
Many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.
